outline: Understanding the impact of prompt quality.
Understanding Zero-shot, One-shot, and Few-shot prompting.

slides.title: Concept Introduction: What is a Good Prompt?
content: Analogy: Prompting like a recipe.
Weak recipe, bad dish; Great recipe, great dish.
Weak prompt, weak AI output; Great prompt, great output.
The best prompts use Clarity, Context, and Constraints (The 3 C's).
slides.narration: What makes a good prompt? Think of a recipe. Weak recipe, bad dish. Great recipe, great dish. Weak prompt, weak AI output. Great prompt, great output. This uses Clarity, Context, Constraints. These are the 3 C's.
slides.image_prompt: Image of a chef looking at a recipe with ingredients. Text overlay: 'A weak prompt gets a weak answer. A great prompt gets a great answer. The best prompts include Clarity, Context, and Constraints (The 3 C's).'

slides.title: The 3 C's: Clarity
content: Be Specific! The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.
Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.
slides.narration: First C: Clarity. Be specific. AI does not know your thoughts. Vague prompts give generic answers. Let's see a demo.
slides.image_prompt: Slide showing 'The 3 C's: Clarity' title. Text: 'Be Specific! The AI doesn't know what you're thinking.' and 'Vague prompts lead to generic, unhelpful answers.'

slides.title: Demonstration 1: Clarity
content: ACTION: Type "Write about electric cars."
OBSERVATION: Generic paragraph appears.
ACTION: Type "Write a short blog post on top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers."
OBSERVATION AGAIN: Focused blog post appears.
COMPARISON: Notice the clearer output.
slides.narration: Open AI chatbot. Type "Write about electric cars." Click Send. Observe generic output. Type "Write a short blog post on top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers." Click Send. Wait for output. See focused blog post. Notice the clearer output.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of opening an AI chatbot, typing the weak prompt, clicking send, showing generic output. Then typing the clear prompt, clicking send, showing focused output, with a visual comparison of both.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Context
content: Give it Background! Context tells the AI why you're asking and who the audience is.
It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.
slides.narration: Next C: Context. Provide background. Tell AI why you ask. Tell AI audience. Helps AI adopt perspective. Let's add context.
slides.image_prompt: Slide showing 'The 3 C's: Context' title. Text: 'Give it Background! Context tells the AI why you're asking and who the audience is.' and 'It helps the AI adopt the right perspective.'

slides.title: Demonstration 2: Context
content: ACTION: Modify prompt to "Write a short blog post for a sustainable living blog. Explain top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers."
OBSERVATION: Blog post with sustainable living focus appears.
COMPARISON: Notice the shift in perspective.
slides.narration: Return to chatbot. Modify prompt: "Write a short blog post for a sustainable living blog. Explain top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers." Click Send. Observe output. Post has sustainable living focus. Compare with previous output. Notice the shift in perspective.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of modifying the previous prompt in an AI chatbot by adding context, clicking send, showing the new output with a sustainable living focus, and comparing it side-by-side with the previous output.

slides.title: The 3 C's: Constraints
content: Set the Rules! Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.
Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.
slides.narration: Last C: Constraints. Set rules for AI. Boundaries shape output. Specify length, format, style. Let's apply constraints.
slides.image_prompt: Slide showing 'The 3 C's: Constraints' title. Text: 'Set the Rules! Constraints are boundaries that shape the output.' and 'Tell the AI the length, format, and style you need.'

slides.title: Demonstration 3: Constraints
content: ACTION: Add constraints to prompt: "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a sustainable living blog. Explain top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers. Use a friendly tone and end with a question."
OBSERVATION: Blog post under 400 words, friendly tone, ends with a question.
COMPARISON: Output matches all requirements.
slides.narration: Go back to chatbot. Add constraints: "Write a short blog post, under 400 words, for a sustainable living blog. Explain top 3 benefits of electric cars for city dwellers. Use a friendly tone and end with a question." Click Send. Observe output. It is under 400 words, friendly, and ends with a question. Compare with previous output. Output matches all requirements.
slides.video_prompt: Screen recording of modifying the previous prompt in an AI chatbot by adding constraints (word count, tone, ending question), clicking send, showing the new output that adheres to all constraints, and comparing it side-by-side with the previous output.

slides.title: Bonus Tip: Persona and Shot Prompting
content: Provide a Persona: Tell the AI who to be (e.g., "Act as an expert travel agent...").
Zero-Shot: No examples given.
One-Shot: One example given to show the pattern.
Few-Shot: A few examples given for complex patterns.
slides.narration: Bonus: Provide a Persona. Tell AI who to act as. Example: "Act as expert travel agent." Also, shot prompting. Zero-shot: No examples. One-shot: One example for pattern. Few-shot: Multiple examples for patterns. These enhance control.
slides.image_prompt: Slide showing 'Bonus Tip: Provide a Persona' with example text. Then 'Zero, One, and Few-Shot Prompting' with definitions for each.

slides.title: Summary
content: Prompt quality directly impacts AI output quality.
The 3 C's: Clarity, Context, and Constraints are crucial.
Clarity means being specific in your request.
Context provides background and audience information.
Constraints set rules for length, format, and style.
Persona and example-based (shot) prompting enhance control.
slides.narration: Summary of key points: Prompt quality impacts AI output. 3 C's are crucial: Clarity, Context, Constraints. Clarity: be specific. Context: provide background. Constraints: set rules. Persona and shot prompting enhance control.
slides.image_prompt: Slide showing 'Summary' title with bullet points summarizing the key takeaways from the tutorial.

slides.title: Assignment
content: Using the 3 C's, write an excellent prompt for an AI chatbot.
Generate a short, persuasive email to convince a friend to join a local community gardening project.
Specify the tone (friendly, encouraging), length (under 150 words), and include a call to action.
Test your prompt in an AI chatbot.
slides.narration: Here is an assignment. Use the 3 C's. Write a prompt for an AI chatbot. Generate a short, persuasive email. Convince a friend to join a community gardening project. Specify tone, length, call to action. Test your prompt.
